# Review Output

## Contents

- Verdict
- Findings
- Evidence

## Verdict

```text
Review: pass|changes-required|blocked
Profile: <broad or replacement specialist>
Mode: <single-agent|local-fallback|skipped>
Fingerprint: base=<sha> tree=<sha> requirements=<sha256> proof=<sha256>
Counts: P0=N P1=N P2=N P3=N
```

## Findings

For each finding provide severity, title, file and line, concrete evidence,
impact, specific fix, routing class, owner, confidence, and verification need.

## Evidence

State whether the reviewer covered intent, test validity, correctness, and code
health. Include residual risk and any untracked or excluded path.
